title: Strange explosions caught on home cameras

tellings.quote: they got pissed off at me a couple of years ago and there they all these explosions, strange explosions got picked up

plain: Around 2022, strange explosions were picked up by the cameras at the home of Whitley Strieber, an author who says he has met non-human beings. Strieber tells this himself, saying the beings "got pissed off at me" and the explosions followed. To him, it is a sign that these visitors act on the physical world and react to what he does.
